heartLegend: The heart marks the part we learn by heart.
writePrompt: Write the word, then bring it back and look.
myWordsHint: We have guessed where the sounds break. Say the word slowly and fix the breaks — then tap the part your class must learn by heart.
workedExample: We will break “one” as o-n-e. Your mouth says /w/ + /u/ + /n/.
seamHint: Tap between the letters to join or split them.
heartHint: Tap the part your class must learn by heart.
sentenceOpt: A sentence for this word (you can leave this empty)
needHeart: Mark a part by heart first — that is what makes it a heart word.
tooManyHearts: If nearly all of it is a heart, the child learns the shape instead of the sounds.
looksDecodable: This one looks like it can be sounded out. Sound Boxes may suit it better.
tooLong: That one is too long for the boxes — try a shorter word.
capReached: The list is full. Remove one to add another.
copied: Copied — paste it anywhere you keep your links.
deviceOnly: Your words stay in this browser, on this device.
gateSave: Keeping your own word list is part of Premium — building one is always free.
printNote: Cut along the dashed line. Fold along the dotted line. The heart marks the part we learn by heart.
homeNote: Write the word in the empty boxes, then colour the heart.
